cohort: 177 women with available data on human milk sodium potassium ratio (Na:K) and dietary intake data
finding: Women without subclinical mastitis had a lower median Dietary Inflammatory Index score than women with moderate or severe subclinical mastitis, and a one-unit increase in Dietary Inflammatory Index was associated with about 41% increased odds of having subclinical mastitis.
mod_finding: While adjusting for mode of delivery in their analysis, this study found that a pro-inflammatory diet may be associated with subclinical mastitis in lactating women.
